Effect Prophet third-party notices
==================================

Effect Prophet is licensed under the MIT License; see LICENSE in the package
root. It includes work adapted from the projects below, whose license terms
are reproduced in this directory.

Prophet
-------
Prophet 1.4.0, https://github.com/facebook/prophet/tree/v1.4.0.
Copyright (c) Facebook, Inc. and its affiliates.
The TypeScript library and the Rust crate reimplement Prophet's model and
forecasting procedures, including the MAP objective from prophet.stan, so that
results match Python Prophet. MIT terms are reproduced in prophet-license.txt.

Stan optimizers
---------------
Stan 2.37.0, commit 1357c136bf22e3f0d25ed3529fea55fe76842eac.
Copyright (c) 2011--2020, Stan Developers and their Assignees.
The Rust port of the Newton optimizer retains the actual finite-difference
stencil, joint spectral modification, backtracking and service stopping
semantics. The L-BFGS update and strong Wolfe line search are ported from
optimization/{bfgs,bfgs_linesearch,lbfgs_update}.hpp. BSD-3-Clause terms are
reproduced in stan-license.txt.

Symmetric spectral decomposition
--------------------------------
nalgebra 0.34.1, https://github.com/dimforge/nalgebra/tree/v0.34.1.
Copyright the nalgebra authors, including Sebastien Crozet.
Apache-2.0 terms are reproduced in apache-2.0-license.txt.
The symmetric QR iteration in symmetric_eigen.rs is adapted from nalgebra's
symmetric_eigen.rs, simplified to f64. Its Householder tridiagonalization
reuses the pinned nalgebra crate.
The QR iteration follows Eigen 3.4.0's dynamic SelfAdjointEigenSolver and
real JacobiRotation arithmetic, including its scaled deflation criterion.
Householder tridiagonalization still comes from nalgebra, so this is not a
bitwise port of Eigen.

Reference-aligned exponential
-----------------------------
Arm optimized-routines, commit 375f32ed2f7098090f41795ad363822752a25a65.
https://github.com/ARM-software/optimized-routines
Copyright (c) 2018-2025 Arm Limited.
src/stan/math.rs and src/stan/math/data.rs adapt math/exp.c and math/exp_data.c to
pure Rust, exact IEEE-754 table bits, explicit fused arithmetic and nearest
rounding. errno/fenv behavior and C ABI aliases are not included. This fixes
host-libm-dependent optimizer trajectories without native or C dependencies.
The MIT license is selected; the upstream license options are reproduced in
arm-optimized-routines-license.txt.

Reference Eigen arithmetic
--------------------------
Eigen 3.4.0, vendored by Stan Math commit
58ad15b0847485d523aadd22cbae7add0a61b0e3.
https://github.com/stan-dev/math/tree/58ad15b0847485d523aadd22cbae7add0a61b0e3/lib/eigen_3.4.0
Copyright Julien Pommier (2007), Pedro Gonnet (2014), Gael Guennebaud
(2008-2019), Jitse Niesen (2010), and Benoit Jacob (2009).
src/stan/eigen_math.rs adapts GenericPacketMathFunctions.h's double packet
exponential to deterministic software lanes without an Eigen ABI or CPU SIMD
requirement. src/symmetric_eigen.rs adapts the QR iteration and deflation from
SelfAdjointEigenSolver.h and real rotations from Jacobi.h. Their modified
source is available under MPL-2.0 in rust/prophet-wasm/src/ at
https://github.com/jer-k/effect-prophet; the terms are reproduced in
eigen-license.txt. No full Eigen eigensolver parity is claimed.

crates below. Each crate offers Apache-2.0, and each is used under it; the
terms are reproduced in apache-2.0-license.txt.
